'''P3-KP''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P3-KP appears in the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]] as a Cartel companion available from the Singularity Pack, added with Patch 5.5.0.
